title: Hardcoded signing key in SIGNING_KEY constant
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/TokenService.java:L18 declares SIGNING_KEY as a static final String literal; any party with read access to the source code can forge tokens by reproducing the MD5-based signature computed in issue().

title: MD5 used as token signing hash in issue()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/TokenService.java:L22 calls MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5") to produce the token signature digest; MD5 is cryptographically broken and allows collision and pre-image attacks, undermining token integrity.
